points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 蔡伦出生于东汉时期的桂阳郡耒阳县（今湖南省耒阳市）。他出身于一个普通农民家庭，自幼聪明好学。由于家境贫寒，蔡伦很早就进入宫廷，成为一名小太监。在宫中，他勤奋好学，善于观察，逐渐获得了汉和帝的赏识。这段经历培养了他细致入微的观察力和动手能力，为他后来的发明创造奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Cai Lun was born in Leiyang County, Guiyang Commandery (modern-day Leiyang City, Hunan Province) during the Eastern Han Dynasty. Born into a peasant family, he was intelligent and studious from a young age. Due to his family's poverty, Cai Lun entered the imperial court as a young eunuch. In the palace, he was diligent in his studies and observant, gradually gaining favor from Emperor He of Han. This experience cultivated his meticulous observation skills and hands-on abilities, laying the foundation for his later inventions.

points.title: 宫廷仕途
points.description: 蔡伦在洛阳的宫廷中逐渐晋升，先后担任小黄门、中常侍等职。在此期间，他不仅参与了朝政，还负责管理皇家手工作坊。蔡伦对工艺技术有着浓厚兴趣，经常在宫廷作坊中研究各种工艺。他还出使过多个地方，接触了各地的造纸技术，积累了丰富的经验。这段时期，蔡伦开始思考改进造纸技术，为后来的发明创造了条件。
points.descriptionEn: In Luoyang, Cai Lun gradually rose through the ranks in the imperial court, serving as Xiaohuangmen and Zhongchangshi. During this period, he not only participated in court affairs but also managed imperial workshops. Cai Lun had a strong interest in craftsmanship and often studied various techniques in the imperial workshops. He also traveled to different regions, learning about papermaking technologies and accumulating extensive experience. During this time, Cai Lun began contemplating improvements to papermaking techniques, laying the groundwork for his later invention.

points.title: 造纸术革新
points.description: 蔡伦在洛阳的宫廷作坊中进行了系统的造纸技术研究。他总结前人经验，创新性地使用树皮、麻头、破布、鱼网等原料，改进了造纸工艺。他发明了捣浆、抄纸、晒纸等一系列工序，大大提高了纸张的质量和产量。公元105年，蔡伦向汉和帝献上自己改进的纸张，被称为'蔡侯纸'。这一发明彻底改变了书写材料的历史，取代了笨重的竹简和昂贵的丝帛，推动了文化知识的传播和保存。
points.descriptionEn: In the imperial workshops of Luoyang, Cai Lun conducted systematic research on papermaking technology. He summarized previous experiences and innovatively used materials such as tree bark, hemp heads, rags, and fishing nets to improve the papermaking process. He invented a series of procedures including pulp beating, paper forming, and drying, significantly improving the quality and output of paper. In 105 AD, Cai Lun presented his improved paper to Emperor He of Han, known as 'Caihou paper'. This invention completely changed the history of writing materials, replacing bulky bamboo slips and expensive silk fabrics, promoting the dissemination and preservation of cultural knowledge.

points.title: 官位提升
points.description: 因造纸术的巨大贡献，蔡伦获得了汉和帝的高度赏识，被提拔为'尚方令'，负责管理皇家手工业。在此期间，他还参与了许多其他工艺技术的改进，如改进炼钢技术、发明指南车等。蔡伦的发明创造不仅推动了科技发展，也增强了东汉的国力。他还积极参与政治活动，成为汉和帝的重要助手。这一时期是蔡伦政治生涯的巅峰，他的影响力达到了顶峰。
points.descriptionEn: Due to his significant contribution to papermaking, Cai Lun received high appreciation from Emperor He of Han and was promoted to 'Shangfang Ling', responsible for managing the imperial handicraft industry. During this period, he also participated in improving other technologies, such as steelmaking techniques and inventing the south-pointing chariot. Cai Lun's inventions not only promoted technological development but also enhanced the power of the Eastern Han Dynasty. He was also actively involved in political activities, becoming an important assistant to Emperor He of Han. This period marked the peak of Cai Lun's political career, with his influence reaching its zenith.

points.title: 晚年遭遇
points.description: 汉和帝去世后，蔡伦的政治地位开始下降。他卷入了宫廷权力斗争，最终在公元121年被迫服毒自杀。尽管如此，他的造纸术发明却流传后世，影响深远。蔡伦的造纸技术通过丝绸之路传播到中亚、西亚，最终传入欧洲，对世界文明产生了巨大影响。他的发明被誉为'中国古代四大发明之一'，对人类文明的进步做出了不可磨灭的贡献。蔡伦虽然结局悲惨，但他的科学精神和创新精神永远被后人铭记。
points.descriptionEn: After Emperor He of Han's death, Cai Lun's political position began to decline. He became embroiled in court power struggles and was eventually forced to commit suicide by poison in 121 AD. Nevertheless, his papermaking invention was passed down through generations, with far-reaching influence. Cai Lun's papermaking technology spread along the Silk Road to Central Asia, West Asia, and eventually to Europe, having a tremendous impact on world civilization. His invention is hailed as one of the 'Four Great Inventions of Ancient China', making an indelible contribution to the progress of human civilization. Although Cai Lun met a tragic end, his scientific spirit and innovative spirit are forever remembered by posterity.

supporter.zh: 蔡伦被誉为中国古代伟大的发明家，他的造纸术发明是人类文明史上的重要里程碑。支持者认为，蔡伦的发明彻底改变了人类记录和传播知识的方式，极大地促进了文化、教育和科学的发展。他的创新精神和实用主义态度为后世科技工作者树立了榜样。蔡伦的造纸术不仅在中国得到广泛应用，还通过丝绸之路传播到世界各地，对人类文明的进步做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
supporter.en: Cai Lun is regarded as a great ancient Chinese inventor, and his papermaking invention represents a significant milestone in the history of human civilization. Supporters believe that Cai Lun's invention completely transformed how humans record and disseminate knowledge, greatly promoting the development of culture, education, and science. His innovative spirit and pragmatic attitude set an example for future scientists and technologists. Cai Lun's papermaking technology was not only widely used in China but also spread throughout the world via the Silk Road, making an indelible contribution to the progress of human civilization.

critic.zh: 批评者指出，蔡伦并非造纸术的真正发明者，而是改良者。考古发现表明，在西汉时期就已经有了早期的纸张，如甘肃放马滩出土的西汉纸。此外，蔡伦作为宦官，其政治生涯也充满争议，他卷入了宫廷权力斗争，最终被迫自杀。批评者认为，历史对蔡伦的过度神化掩盖了造纸术发展的复杂历史过程，也忽视了许多无名工匠的贡献。蔡伦的案例也反映了古代中国科技发明与政治权力紧密结合的特点。
critic.en: Critics point out that Cai Lun was not the true inventor of papermaking but rather an improver. Archaeological discoveries show that early forms of paper already existed during the Western Han Dynasty, such as the Western Han paper unearthed from Fangmatan in Gansu. Additionally, as a eunuch, Cai Lun's political career was controversial, involving him in court power struggles that ultimately led to his forced suicide. Critics argue that the over-mythologization of Cai Lun in history obscures the complex historical process of papermaking development and neglects the contributions of numerous anonymous craftsmen. Cai Lun's case also reflects the close connection between technological invention and political power in ancient China.

objective.zh: 从客观历史视角看，蔡伦是中国古代科技发展史上的重要人物，但他的贡献需要放在更广阔的历史背景中理解。造纸术的发明是一个渐进过程，蔡伦的改良是这一过程中的关键节点。在流行文化中，蔡伦常被塑造成'四大发明'的代表人物，象征着中国古代科技成就。历史学界普遍认为，蔡伦的造纸术确实极大地推动了文化传播，但这一技术的传播和演变是一个复杂的历史过程，涉及多民族、多文化的交流与融合。蔡伦的生平也反映了东汉时期宫廷政治与科技发展的关系。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Cai Lun is an important figure in the history of ancient Chinese technological development, but his contributions need to be understood within a broader historical context. The invention of papermaking was a gradual process, and Cai Lun's improvement represented a key node in this process. In popular culture, Cai Lun is often portrayed as a representative of the 'Four Great Inventions', symbolizing ancient Chinese technological achievements. The academic community generally agrees that Cai Lun's papermaking greatly promoted cultural dissemination, but the spread and evolution of this technology was a complex historical process involving exchanges and integration among multiple ethnic groups and cultures. Cai Lun's life also reflects the relationship between court politics and technological development during the Eastern Han Dynasty.

self.en: If you want to do a good job, you must first sharpen your tools.

others.zh: 蔡伦之纸，天下通用，自是莫不从用，天下咸称蔡侯纸。
others.en: Cai Lun's paper was used throughout the world, and from then on, everyone used it. The world came to call it 'Caihou paper'.
